subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should WebChat non-resumable restart recovery be fixed now by persisting a synthetic assistant notice in the transcript, or should maintainers hold this issue for a broader restart recovery redesign?
rationale: Both approaches can address the user-visible blank/lost notice, but they encode different product contracts for WebChat transcript history and restart recovery ownership.

options.title: Land scoped transcript notice
options.body: Proceed with PR #95154 or an equivalent scoped implementation so WebChat users see the recovery failure without waiting for a larger redesign.

options.title: Fold into broader recovery
options.body: Keep the issue open under the larger reattach/restart-recovery direction and avoid adding a synthetic transcript notice contract now.

options.title: Close as intentional behavior
options.body: Decide that WebChat restart-recovery failures should not persist a notice and close this with that product rationale.

recommendation.title: Land scoped transcript notice
recommendation.body: Proceed with PR #95154 or an equivalent scoped implementation so WebChat users see the recovery failure without waiting for a larger redesign.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses delivery mirrors, WebChat transcript behavior, and restart deferral, where this history is most central.
